name: iterant-proxy-guestpark
description: Cloudflare Worker that proxies requests to the Iterant platform for seamless landing page integration
author: Iterant AI

TARGET_HOST.description: The Iterant origin that serves your pages, host only. Iterant gives you this: it looks like your-brand.iterant.site.

BRAND_ID.description: The brand this proxy serves, a UUID from your Iterant dashboard.

CACHE_TTL.description: Seconds to cache a proxied page at the edge. 3600 is a good default; 0 caches nothing.
